notes: Corrected the place-name phrase on the same ground as the identical formula elsewhere in the chapter: with that standing before the rectum's own word, rule 41's arthrous count governs, so the article on hammāqôm is unrepresented and the phrase's single the is supplied on the construct šēm.
The demonstrative pronoun hûʾ takes that and its agreement article goes unrepresented; the ASV writes one determiner for the pair.

The competing reading, which the accepted alignment took, reads the written the as fronted from the rectum's article; rule 29's fronting answers to an anarthrous rectum, and here the rectum's own word carries a determiner.
